row.reason: Both sell employee benefits administration to employers. HealthEquity's core is HSA custody and consumer-directed accounts (HSA, FSA, HRA, COBRA, commuter), and it earns custodial, interchange and service fees. Alight is a broad benefits, payroll and HR outsourcing and platform provider for large enterprises. It is paid through subscription and service fees. The evidence shows no HSA custody at Alight. The customers overlap and the products only partly overlap, so this is adjacent.
